evidence.description: A black Kia SUV rammed the doors; nothing was taken

notes: Cannabis shop, attempt. The source gives only a weekday, the Thursday before the article of 8 Aug 2025, so the date is left empty. The article says no information has been provided on a connection between the two West Seattle incidents. The MyNorthwest page was read by the research team but returned HTTP 403 to a later check, so it was not re-verified. No police statement links this incident to any other incident in the set.
